mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5 percentage points, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint growth in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates reduce liquidity and increase discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of monetary tightening cycles, or regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100k, or Rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in quarterly GDP and housing starts indicates a broad-based economic recovery, increasing corporate earnings visibility and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint expansion in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, strong retail sales growth signals overheating and impending policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of late-cycle expansion periods with RSAFS growth, or regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.04.
